'''Ditto''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked alongside [[Laurn]] as the leader of a [[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gang]] on [[Hallitron-7/Legends|Hallitron-7]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], he and Laurn were hired by [[Ferus Olin]] to escort him to a spaceport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He hesitated at first, but Ferus convinced him the credits he had.<ref name="LOTJR" />
